classification.difficultyReason: Reverse subtracted vectors, rearrange terms into connected paths and apply the taught vector laws, including cancellation to the zero vector.

content.prompt: Prove the following. Show your steps clearly and state the laws used.

answer.short: $\overrightarrow{PS}$, using the negative vector law and triangle law.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}&\phantom{= }\overrightarrow{PQ}-\overrightarrow{RQ}+\overrightarrow{RS}\\&=\overrightarrow{PQ}+\overrightarrow{QR}+\overrightarrow{RS}\\&=\overrightarrow{PR}+\overrightarrow{RS}\\&=\overrightarrow{PS}\end{aligned}$$
Laws used, in order: negative vector law; triangle law; triangle law.

answer.short: $\overrightarrow{AD}$, using the negative vector law and triangle law.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}&\phantom{= }\overrightarrow{AB}-\overrightarrow{CB}+\overrightarrow{CD}\\&=\overrightarrow{AB}+\overrightarrow{BC}+\overrightarrow{CD}\\&=\overrightarrow{AC}+\overrightarrow{CD}\\&=\overrightarrow{AD}\end{aligned}$$
Laws used, in order: negative vector law; triangle law; triangle law.

answer.short: $2\overrightarrow{NM}$, using the parallelogram law of subtraction and collecting equal vectors.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}&\phantom{= }\overrightarrow{OM}-\overrightarrow{ON}+\overrightarrow{NM}\\&=\overrightarrow{NM}+\overrightarrow{NM}\\&=2\overrightarrow{NM}\end{aligned}$$
First use the parallelogram law of subtraction, then collect equal vectors.

answer.short: $\overrightarrow{PS}$, using the negative vector law and triangle law.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}&\phantom{= }\overrightarrow{PR}-\overrightarrow{QR}+\overrightarrow{QS}\\&=\overrightarrow{PR}+\overrightarrow{RQ}+\overrightarrow{QS}\\&=\overrightarrow{PQ}+\overrightarrow{QS}\\&=\overrightarrow{PS}\end{aligned}$$
Laws used, in order: negative vector law; triangle law; triangle law.

answer.short: $2\overrightarrow{FG}$, using the parallelogram law of subtraction and negative vector law.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}&\phantom{= }\overrightarrow{EG}-\overrightarrow{EF}-\overrightarrow{GF}\\&=\overrightarrow{FG}-\overrightarrow{GF}\\&=\overrightarrow{FG}+\overrightarrow{FG}\\&=2\overrightarrow{FG}\end{aligned}$$
First use the parallelogram law of subtraction, then the negative vector law, then collect equal vectors.

answer.short: $2\overrightarrow{RT}$, using the parallelogram law of subtraction and negative vector law.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}&\phantom{= }\overrightarrow{PT}-\overrightarrow{PR}-\overrightarrow{TR}\\&=\overrightarrow{RT}-\overrightarrow{TR}\\&=\overrightarrow{RT}+\overrightarrow{RT}\\&=2\overrightarrow{RT}\end{aligned}$$
First use the parallelogram law of subtraction, then the negative vector law, then collect equal vectors.

answer.short: $\overrightarrow{LP}$, using the negative vector, commutative and triangle laws.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}&\phantom{= }\overrightarrow{MN}-\overrightarrow{PN}+\overrightarrow{LM}\\&=\overrightarrow{MN}+\overrightarrow{NP}+\overrightarrow{LM}\\&=\overrightarrow{LM}+\overrightarrow{MN}+\overrightarrow{NP}\\&=\overrightarrow{LN}+\overrightarrow{NP}\\&=\overrightarrow{LP}\end{aligned}$$
Laws used, in order: negative vector law; commutative law; triangle law; triangle law.

answer.short: $\overrightarrow{AE}$, using the negative vector law and triangle law.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}&\phantom{= }\overrightarrow{AB}-\overrightarrow{CB}-\overrightarrow{DC}-\overrightarrow{ED}\\&=\overrightarrow{AB}+\overrightarrow{BC}+\overrightarrow{CD}+\overrightarrow{DE}\\&=\overrightarrow{AC}+\overrightarrow{CD}+\overrightarrow{DE}\\&=\overrightarrow{AD}+\overrightarrow{DE}\\&=\overrightarrow{AE}\end{aligned}$$
Laws used, in order: negative vector law; triangle law; triangle law; triangle law.

answer.short: $\underset{\sim}{0}$, using the negative vector, commutative and triangle laws, then adding opposite vectors.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}&\phantom{= }\overrightarrow{BC}-\overrightarrow{BA}-\overrightarrow{DC}-\overrightarrow{AD}\\&=\overrightarrow{BC}+\overrightarrow{AB}+\overrightarrow{CD}+\overrightarrow{DA}\\&=\overrightarrow{AB}+\overrightarrow{BC}+\overrightarrow{CD}+\overrightarrow{DA}\\&=\overrightarrow{AC}+\overrightarrow{CD}+\overrightarrow{DA}\\&=\overrightarrow{AD}+\overrightarrow{DA}\\&=\underset{\sim}{0}\end{aligned}$$
Laws used, in order: negative vector law; commutative law; triangle law; triangle law; opposite vectors sum to the zero vector.

answer.short: $2\overrightarrow{ZY}$, using the commutative law and parallelogram law of subtraction.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}&\phantom{= }-\overrightarrow{XZ}+\overrightarrow{XY}+\overrightarrow{ZY}\\&=\overrightarrow{XY}-\overrightarrow{XZ}+\overrightarrow{ZY}\\&=\overrightarrow{ZY}+\overrightarrow{ZY}\\&=2\overrightarrow{ZY}\end{aligned}$$
First use the commutative law, then the parallelogram law of subtraction, then collect equal vectors.
